feature.label: Bulk Format (incl. Subfolders)
feature.description: Formats all files of a package, folder or project including subpackages and subfolders, each with the formatter Eclipse would use for it (Java, XML, HTML, CSS, JSON, YAML, JavaScript, ...). Adds "Source > Format (incl. Subpackages)" to packages and "Format (incl. Subfolders)" to folders and projects.
